items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola Dark
items.detail: Rare drop from Nuka-Cola mystery machine, or find in Eta Psi house basement on Fraternity Row

items.title: Complete a Daily Quest
items.detail: Cop a Squatter at Watoga Emergency Services is usually quick

items.title: Craft a Grenade, Mine, or Thrown Weapon
items.detail: Use Tinker's workbench at your C.A.M.P. or Whitespring Resort

items.title: Drink Canned Coffee
items.detail: Brew from coffee machine at C.A.M.P. or find on Crab Shack roof near Toxic Dried Lakebed

items.title: Kill a Human while under the effects of Psycho
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant for cultist spawns, use Psycho before killing

items.title: Kill a Spooky Scorched
items.detail: Morgantown Airport is a reliable spawn location during the Spooky Scorched event

items.title: Sell a Tesla Rifle to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Any vendor will buy it; Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to vendors at train stations for fastest results

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: The General's Steakhouse in the Mire has five to eight gnomes in the walled garden and shed

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and complete the Daily Operation instance

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start from Bounty Board at Highway Town in Burning Springs, then eliminate the assigned Outlaw

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has dependable robot spawns; energy weapons work well

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Plant vegetables at your C.A.M.P. or gather from Silva Homestead in the Forest

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Found around cabins and campgrounds; equip any costume piece before the kill

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Wavy Willard's Water Park in Toxic Valley has a dozen Scorched in one loop

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it

events.name: Night at the Morgue
events.description: Mini Season ticket event with candy bowl challenges and trick-or-treat activities.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Spooky Scorched enemies with Halloween costumes and special rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Double XP weekend event for faster character progression.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance of catching seasonal fish this weekend.
